items.title: Nomads Hostels Owner
items.description: Owner of Nomads hostel chain in Thailand. Role: oversees marketing, coding, development, and systems management. Runs every department solo. Uses Obsidian Second Brain for PKM.

items.title: Terminal-Based Workflow Preference
items.description: Prefers command-line tools and terminal-based workflows. Requested CLI-based Obsidian sync solution to trigger sync without opening GUI application. Investigating headless sync alternatives due to CLI preference.

items.title: B2C Consumer Market Interest
items.description: Interested in B2C (business-to-consumer) money-making ideas, not B2B (selling to other businesses). Broadened scope beyond hospitality industry after initial hostel-focused suggestions. Exploring AI dating, personal productivity, creator tools, and other consumer markets.

items.title: B2C vs B2B Scope Clarification
items.description: When presented with B2B (SaaS, agency) ideas, Trevor clarified "I wasn't b2c" - wanted B2C ideas (selling directly to consumers, not business-to-business services). Corrected earlier understanding.

items.title: Online/Coding Money-Making Ideas
items.description: Requested ideas for earning more money through online or coding projects. Generated 7 B2C concepts including AI Dating Assistant, Personal AI Chief of Staff, AI Content Studio for Creators, and other productivity tools.

items.title: MEWS Authentication: AccessToken Only
items.description: Trevor confirmed MEWS Connector API authentication should use AccessToken only (not ClientToken + AccessToken as documented). Reason: MEWS integration is installed per property on MEWS side, so single AccessToken identifies both application and property. Forwarded to sub-agent to update nomads-ops-center implementation.

items.title: Real-Time Web Access for Price Monitoring
items.description: Trevor requested real-time web access with most token-friendly approach for Hostelworld price monitoring. Wanted solution that gives best data while minimizing API/LLM token costs. Resulted in decision to use Agent Browser CLI for scraping with minimal LLM involvement.

items.title: Clawd Configuration Backup to GitHub
items.description: Trevor requested Clawd configuration directory be pushed to GitHub as 'calwd-second-brain' repository. Successfully created public repo at https://github.com/tddixon/calwd-second-brain containing AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md configuration files, skills/ directory (30+ installed skills), memory/ session logs, and docs/ documentation. Git identity configured as Trevor (trevor@nomads.com) for the initial commit.

items.title: tmux Mobile Optimization
items.description: Requested enabling all tmux mobile optimizations on 2026-01-30 at 19:17 UTC. Applied mouse support, prefix key change to Ctrl+a, vim-style navigation, top status bar, and TPM plugins (resurrect, continuum, yank).

items.title: tmux Scroll Shortcuts
items.description: Requested mobile shortcut to scroll terminal page up and down to read last messages (2026-01-30 ~19:52 UTC). Added Alt+u/d for half page scroll, Alt+↑/↓ and Shift+↑/↓ for line scroll.

items.title: Ops Integration Plan - Save Only
items.description: Trevor requested the Nomads Ops integration plan be saved as MD document only, not executed. Reason: Still finishing development on MEWS-Klaviyo sync and does not want to combine until it's done. Plan created at /home/desktop/clawd/NOMADS-OPS-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md on 2026-01-30.

items.title: Daily Plan Summary to PKM
items.description: Requested daily plan summary be added to Second Brain PKM via sub-agent on 2026-01-30 at 18:59 UTC. Created /home/desktop/obsidian-second-brain/01-Daily-Notes/2026-01-30.md with session summary.

items.title: Hostelworld Price Monitoring Rebuild
items.description: Approved Hostelworld price monitoring rebuild on 2026-01-31 at 05:52 UTC. Approved two fixes: (1) Rebuild script with Playwright for real-time JavaScript pricing, (2) Set up daily cron at 6 AM Thailand time with Telegram notifications. Script now at /home/desktop/clawd/scripts/hostelworld-price-monitor.cjs

items.title: Ao Nang Pricing Strategy Review
items.description: Reviewed Hostelworld price monitoring data on 2026-01-31 at 06:20 UTC. Playwright script captured Aug 1, 2025 snapshot: Nomads avg $31.77 vs competitors avg $25.47 (24.7% premium). Nomads maintains highest ratings (9.4-9.6 Superb) justifying premium positioning. Whoopers Hostel identified as closest competitor with similar pricing ($33.17) and rating (9.2).

items.title: Add Implementation Plans to ClickUp and Obsidian PKM
items.description: Requested adding implementation plans and research to ClickUp and Obsidian PKM on 2026-01-31 at 16:56 UTC. Three projects: Noho Ops (Klaviyo integration - 5-week roadmap at NOHO-OPS-INTEGRATION-PLAN-V2.md), Mews/Kayvio (MEWS + Klaviyo integration), and Poster Sync (Poster POS → MEWS sync functionality built Jan 30). Spawns sub-agent 'clickup-obsidian-sync' to handle the task.

items.title: Install Hybrid Memory Skill from ClawdHub
items.description: Requested installation of clawdhub hybrid-memory skill and setup on 2026-01-31 at 17:07 UTC. Hybrid memory combines OpenClaw's built-in vector memory with Graphiti temporal knowledge graph for enhanced recall of temporal facts and conversation history.
